Container.Name: mediahub-bot
Container.Overview: Discord bot for a Plex + Seerr + Radarr/Sonarr + Tautulli + Lidarr/Aurral + Wizarr stack: requests, new-content announcements with @-pings, a live status board, Wizarr invites and music streaming into voice channels. To reach other containers by name (http://lidarr:8686), set Network Type to the same custom network they use; on plain bridge, use http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:PORT addresses instead.
Container.Requires: A Discord bot token (see the project README). Every media service is optional.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Small SQLite state: status-board message, request history, invite nicknames.

Config.Name: Webhook port
Config.Description: Where Seerr/Tautulli/*arr/Aurral post webhooks (POST /webhook/<service>).

Config.Name: DISCORD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Discord — Required. Bot token: Discord Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token.

Config.Name: GUILD_ID
Config.Description: Discord — Required. Your server's ID (Discord: User Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode on, then right-click the server icon → Copy Server ID). Commands register here only.

Config.Name: ADMIN_ROLE_ID
Config.Description: Discord — Admin role: /setup …, /statusboard repost, unlimited /invite, /aurral link, seeing everyone's invites (right-click role → Copy Role ID). If unset, Discord's Administrator permission counts as admin.

Config.Name: STATUS_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: Channels (right-click channel → Copy Channel ID) — Easier: leave these empty and set them from Discord with /setup channels. Values set there are stored by the bot and win over these. Live status board + "service down/recovered" heads-ups. Unset = no board (/status still works).

Config.Name: NOTIFY_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: Channels (right-click channel → Copy Channel ID) — New-content announcements and "@you, your request is ready" pings.

Config.Name: ADMIN_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: Channels (right-click channel → Copy Channel ID) — Admin-only notices: *arr health issues, failed downloads, webhook tests, invite audit log. Falls back to STATUS_CHANNEL_ID when unset.

Config.Name: ROLE_MOVIES_ID
Config.Description: Ping roles (/pings) — The bot creates Movies, TV, Music and Server status roles itself (/setup welcome or /setup pings). They only control who gets @-pinged; every feature is open to everyone. Only set these to reuse roles you already have (right-click role → Copy Role ID).

Config.Name: ROLE_TV_ID
Config.Description: Ping roles (/pings)

Config.Name: ROLE_MUSIC_ID
Config.Description: Ping roles (/pings)

Config.Name: ROLE_STATUS_ID
Config.Description: Ping roles (/pings)

Config.Name: MUSIC_NOTIFY_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: Ping roles (/pings) — Optional separate channel for album announcements. Unset = NOTIFY_CHANNEL_ID. Also settable with /setup channels music_announcements:#channel.

Config.Name: AURRAL_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Public links shown to members — Also settable from Discord with /setup links (stored by the bot, wins over these). Where members open Aurral (shown with their login after /aurral signup).

Config.Name: PLEZY_RELAY_URL
Config.Description: Public links shown to members — Your self-hosted Plezy Watch Together relay, shown in the Plezy guide. Empty = Plezy's default.

Config.Name: INVITER_ROLE_ID
Config.Description: Self-serve invites — Members with this role can create Wizarr invites and /aurral create accounts for others (admins always can).

Config.Name: INVITER_MAX_ACTIVE
Config.Description: Self-serve invites — Max active invites per inviter (0 = no cap). Admins are never capped.

Config.Name: INVITER_EXPIRY_DAYS
Config.Description: Self-serve invites — Longest expiry an inviter can choose: 1, 7 or 30 days (Wizarr's options). Their links are always single use.

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_PORT
Config.Description: Webhook server — Port the bot listens on for POST /webhook/<service> and GET /healthz.

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Webhook server — Shared secret senders must present as ?secret=..., an X-Webhook-Secret header, or "Authorization: Bearer ...". Strongly recommended. Generate: openssl rand -hex 24

Config.Name: SEERR_URL
Config.Description: Seerr: /request movie|series, request stats, status line — Seerr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: SEERR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Seerr: /request movie|series, request stats, status line

Config.Name: SEERR_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Seerr: /request movie|series, request stats, status line — Optional public URL, used only to make result titles clickable links.

Config.Name: SEERR_ATTRIBUTE_USERS
Config.Description: Seerr: /request movie|series, request stats, status line — true = attribute each request to the Seerr user whose profile has the requester's Discord ID (Profile → Settings → Notifications → Discord ID). Requests still auto-approve either way, because the bot calls Seerr with the admin API key.

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: Plex: /random movie, /stats, status line — Plex in host network mode? Use the host IP instead of a container name.

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Plex: /random movie, /stats, status line — How to find it: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436

Config.Name: PLEX_MOVIE_LIBRARIES
Config.Description: Plex: /random movie, /stats, status line — Optional comma-separated movie library names for /random movie (default: all movie libraries).

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_URL
Config.Description: Tautulli: status line (+ inbound webhooks, see README) — Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface → API → API key.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Tautulli: status line (+ inbound webhooks, see README)

Config.Name: LIDARR_URL
Config.Description: Lidarr: /request album, /stats, status line — Lidarr → Settings → General → Security → API Key.

Config.Name: LIDARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Lidarr: /request album, /stats, status line

Config.Name: LIDARR_ROOT_FOLDER
Config.Description: Lidarr: /request album, /stats, status line — Defaults used when the bot has to add a new artist. Each may be left empty to use Lidarr's first configured entry. Root folder path exactly as shown in Lidarr → Settings → Media Management (e.g. /music).

Config.Name: LIDARR_QUALITY_PROFILE
Config.Description: Lidarr: /request album, /stats, status line — Quality profile name or ID (Settings → Profiles).

Config.Name: LIDARR_METADATA_PROFILE
Config.Description: Lidarr: /request album, /stats, status line — Metadata profile name or ID (Settings → Profiles). Lidarr requires one to add an artist.

Config.Name: AURRAL_URL
Config.Description: Aurral: /request album (fallback or primary), status line — Admin API key: Aurral → Settings → General → API access.

Config.Name: AURRAL_API_KEY
Config.Description: Aurral: /request album (fallback or primary), status line

Config.Name: MUSIC_REQUEST_TARGET
Config.Description: Aurral: /request album (fallback or primary), status line — Where /request album goes first: lidarr or aurral. The other one is the fallback when the first is unreachable or doesn't have the album.

Config.Name: NAVIDROME_URL
Config.Description: Navidrome: status line only — Leave empty if you only use Aurral's built-in Subsonic server.

Config.Name: SUBSONIC_URL
Config.Description: Music streaming into voice channels (/music) — Any Subsonic server: Aurral's built-in one (same address as AURRAL_URL) or Navidrome. Leave empty to use AURRAL_URL. Create a dedicated user for the bot (e.g. "discord") and make sure Opus transcoding works; the bot asks for format=opus so it never transcodes itself.

Config.Name: SUBSONIC_USER
Config.Description: Music streaming into voice channels (/music)

Config.Name: SUBSONIC_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Music streaming into voice channels (/music)

Config.Name: MUSIC_BITRATE
Config.Description: Music streaming into voice channels (/music) — Stream bitrate in kbps (Discord voice tops out around 128 on unboosted servers).

Config.Name: MUSIC_IDLE_MINUTES
Config.Description: Music streaming into voice channels (/music) — Leave the voice channel after this many minutes with nothing playing or nobody listening.

Config.Name: WIZARR_URL
Config.Description: Wizarr: /invite create|list|revoke, status line — Wizarr → Settings → API Keys → Create (the key is shown once).

Config.Name: WIZARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Wizarr: /invite create|list|revoke, status line

Config.Name: WIZARR_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Wizarr: /invite create|list|revoke, status line — The address friends open, used to build the invite links the bot hands out (e.g. https://join.example.com). Without it, links use WIZARR_URL.

Config.Name: WIZARR_SERVER_IDS
Config.Description: Wizarr: /invite create|list|revoke, status line — Optional comma-separated Wizarr server IDs to invite to. Default: every verified Plex server in Wizarr.

Config.Name: RADARR_URL
Config.Description: Radarr / Sonarr: status lines (+ inbound webhooks, see README) — The API key is optional: with it the bot checks /api/v3/system/status (validates the key), without it the unauthenticated /ping. Settings → General → Security → API Key.

Config.Name: RADARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Radarr / Sonarr: status lines (+ inbound webhooks, see README)

Config.Name: SONARR_URL
Config.Description: Radarr / Sonarr: status lines (+ inbound webhooks, see README)

Config.Name: SONARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Radarr / Sonarr: status lines (+ inbound webhooks, see README)

Config.Name: NOTIFY_BATCH_SECONDS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Notification batch window: events arriving within it become one message per channel.

Config.Name: NOTIFY_DEDUPE_HOURS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Don't re-announce the same title (e.g. Radarr then Seerr then Tautulli) within this many hours.

Config.Name: REQUEST_RECONCILE_MINUTES
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — How often to poll Seerr/Lidarr/Aurral for bot requests that finished while a webhook was missed or the bot was down. 0 disables polling (webhooks only).

Config.Name: REQUEST_TRACK_DAYS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Stop waiting to @ someone about a request after this many days.

Config.Name: STATS_REFRESH_MINUTES
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — How often the stats board (/setup stats) re-checks the numbers. It only edits when one changes.

Config.Name: STATUS_INTERVAL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Health-check interval for the status board (minimum 15).

Config.Name: STATUS_REFRESH_MINUTES
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — When nothing changed, refresh latencies/timestamp on the board at most this often.

Config.Name: STATUS_FAIL_THRESHOLD
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Consecutive failed checks before a service counts as down (avoids alerting on a blip).

Config.Name: STATUS_SLOW_MS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Responses slower than this (ms) mark a service as slow (yellow board).

Config.Name: HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Timeout for normal API calls (ms). Health checks always use 5000.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — debug | info | warn | error

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container (Docker only) — User/group the bot runs as; /data is chowned to them on start. Unraid default: 99/100.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container (Docker only)

Config.Name: PROMOTE_SECRET
Config.Description: Reserved — Listed in the original spec alongside "promotion buttons", but no promotion feature was specified, so nothing reads it yet. Safe to leave empty.
